WITH sma_10004_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) AS metric_time__day
    , store_id AS store
    , home_store_id AS home_store
    , 1 AS __order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __paid_order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __valid_order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __cancelled_order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __refund_order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 AND refund_cents < paid_cents THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __partial_refund_order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents > 0 AND refund_cents = paid_cents THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __full_refund_order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents ELSE 0 END AS __payment_cents
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN refund_cents ELSE 0 END AS __refund_cents
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END AS __net_sales_cents
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents ELSE 0 END AS __gross_cents
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents - paid_cents ELSE 0 END AS __discount_cents
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id ELSE NULL END AS __buyer_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id ELSE NULL END AS __refund_buyer_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN store_id ELSE NULL END AS __selling_store_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN quantity ELSE 0 END AS __valid_order_items
  FROM "data"."main"."order_fact" order_model_src_10000
)

, rss_10001_cte AS (
  SELECT
    region
    , store_id AS home_store
  FROM "data"."main"."home_store_dim" home_store_model_src_10000
)

, rss_10006_cte AS (
  SELECT
    region
    , store_id AS store
  FROM "data"."main"."selling_store_dim" selling_store_model_src_10000
)

SELECT
  COALESCE(subq_27.home_store__region, subq_38.home_store__region) AS home_store__region
  , COALESCE(subq_27.store__region, subq_38.store__region) AS store__region
  , MAX(subq_27.order_count) AS order_count
  , MAX(subq_27.paid_order_count) AS paid_order_count
  , MAX(subq_27.valid_order_count) AS valid_order_count
  , MAX(subq_27.cancelled_order_count) AS cancelled_order_count
  , MAX(subq_27.refund_order_count) AS refund_order_count
  , MAX(subq_27.partial_refund_order_count) AS partial_refund_order_count
  , MAX(subq_27.full_refund_order_count) AS full_refund_order_count
  , MAX(subq_27.payment_cents) AS payment_cents
  , MAX(subq_27.refund_cents) AS refund_cents
  , MAX(subq_27.net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents
  , MAX(subq_27.gross_cents) AS gross_cents
  , MAX(subq_27.discount_cents) AS discount_cents
  , MAX(subq_27.buyer_count) AS buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_27.refund_buyer_count) AS refund_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_27.selling_store_count) AS selling_store_count
  , MAX(subq_27.valid_order_items) AS valid_order_items
  , MAX(CAST(subq_38.net_sales_cents AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_38.valid_order_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_order_value
  , MAX(CAST(subq_38.net_sales_cents AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_38.buyer_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_buyer_value
  , MAX(CAST(subq_38.valid_order_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_38.buyer_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS purchase_frequency
  , MAX(CAST(subq_38.refund_cents AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_38.payment_cents, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS refund_amount_rate
  , MAX(CAST(subq_38.cancelled_order_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_38.order_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS cancel_rate
  , MAX(CAST(subq_38.refund_order_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_38.paid_order_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS refund_order_rate
  , MAX(CAST(subq_38.discount_cents AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_38.gross_cents, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS discount_rate
  , MAX(CAST(subq_38.valid_order_items AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_38.valid_order_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS items_per_order
FROM (
  SELECT
    rss_10001_cte.region AS home_store__region
    , rss_10006_cte.region AS store__region
    , SUM(subq_18.__order_count) AS order_count
    , SUM(subq_18.__paid_order_count) AS paid_order_count
    , SUM(subq_18.__valid_order_count) AS valid_order_count
    , SUM(subq_18.__cancelled_order_count) AS cancelled_order_count
    , SUM(subq_18.__refund_order_count) AS refund_order_count
    , SUM(subq_18.__partial_refund_order_count) AS partial_refund_order_count
    , SUM(subq_18.__full_refund_order_count) AS full_refund_order_count
    , SUM(subq_18.__payment_cents) AS payment_cents
    , SUM(subq_18.__refund_cents) AS refund_cents
    , SUM(subq_18.__net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents
    , SUM(subq_18.__gross_cents) AS gross_cents
    , SUM(subq_18.__discount_cents) AS discount_cents
    , COUNT(DISTINCT subq_18.__buyer_count) AS buyer_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT subq_18.__refund_buyer_count) AS refund_buyer_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT subq_18.__selling_store_count) AS selling_store_count
    , SUM(subq_18.__valid_order_items) AS valid_order_items
  FROM (
    SELECT
      store
      , home_store
      , __order_count
      , __paid_order_count
      , __valid_order_count
      , __cancelled_order_count
      , __refund_order_count
      , __partial_refund_order_count
      , __full_refund_order_count
      , __payment_cents
      , __refund_cents
      , __net_sales_cents
      , __gross_cents
      , __discount_cents
      , __buyer_count
      , __refund_buyer_count
      , __selling_store_count
      , __valid_order_items
    FROM sma_10004_cte
    WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  ) subq_18
  LEFT OUTER JOIN
    rss_10001_cte
  ON
    subq_18.home_store = rss_10001_cte.home_store
  LEFT OUTER JOIN
    rss_10006_cte
  ON
    subq_18.store = rss_10006_cte.store
  GROUP BY
    rss_10001_cte.region
    , rss_10006_cte.region
) subq_27
FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT
    rss_10001_cte.region AS home_store__region
    , rss_10006_cte.region AS store__region
    , SUM(subq_29.__net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents
    , SUM(subq_29.__valid_order_count) AS valid_order_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT subq_29.__buyer_count) AS buyer_count
    , SUM(subq_29.__refund_cents) AS refund_cents
    , SUM(subq_29.__payment_cents) AS payment_cents
    , SUM(subq_29.__cancelled_order_count) AS cancelled_order_count
    , SUM(subq_29.__order_count) AS order_count
    , SUM(subq_29.__refund_order_count) AS refund_order_count
    , SUM(subq_29.__paid_order_count) AS paid_order_count
    , SUM(subq_29.__discount_cents) AS discount_cents
    , SUM(subq_29.__gross_cents) AS gross_cents
    , SUM(subq_29.__valid_order_items) AS valid_order_items
  FROM (
    SELECT
      store
      , home_store
      , __order_count
      , __paid_order_count
      , __valid_order_count
      , __cancelled_order_count
      , __refund_order_count
      , __payment_cents
      , __refund_cents
      , __net_sales_cents
      , __gross_cents
      , __discount_cents
      , __buyer_count
      , __valid_order_items
    FROM sma_10004_cte
    WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  ) subq_29
  LEFT OUTER JOIN
    rss_10001_cte
  ON
    subq_29.home_store = rss_10001_cte.home_store
  LEFT OUTER JOIN
    rss_10006_cte
  ON
    subq_29.store = rss_10006_cte.store
  GROUP BY
    rss_10001_cte.region
    , rss_10006_cte.region
) subq_38
ON
  (
    subq_27.home_store__region = subq_38.home_store__region
  ) AND (
    subq_27.store__region = subq_38.store__region
  )
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(subq_27.home_store__region, subq_38.home_store__region)
  , COALESCE(subq_27.store__region, subq_38.store__region)
